data.long_meaning: The name Omdev is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Om’ which represents the supreme deity and the sound of the universe. The suffix ‘dev’ means God or deity. The name signifies devotion and surrender to Lord Om. The name Omdev carries the meaning “Bow to Lord Om” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Omdev usually hope their child will grow to embody bow to lord om and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is ubiquitous in Hindu religious practices and is often used to signify the beginning and end of rituals. The name Omdev may be used to invoke the blessings of Lord Om, emphasizing the connection between the Hindu spiritual Tradition and the individual.

The syllable 'Om' signifies the divine and the association with the suffix 'dev' further emphasizes this. For someone named Omdev, the name serves as a constant reminder of their devotion and surrender to the divine. It is a name that inspires inner peace, contemplation, and a connection to the divine.
